description: Launches a system alert dialog with a title, message, and optional buttons. Works on both iOS and Android. iOS also supports prompts with text input.

alert.signature: static alert(title: string, message?: string, buttons?: AlertButton[], options?: AlertOptions)
alert.description: Shows an alert with a title, optional message, optional buttons, and optional configuration options.

parameters.title: string (required) - Dialog title. Passing null or empty hides title.

prompt.signature: static prompt(title: string, message?: string, callbackOrButtons?: ((text: string) => void) | AlertButton[], type?: AlertType, defaultValue?: string, keyboardType?: string)
prompt.description: Shows a prompt alert that allows text input.

parameters.title: string (required) - Dialog title
parameters.callbackOrButtons: Function or AlertButton[] - Called with text input value or array of buttons
parameters.defaultValue: string (optional) - Default value for text input

AlertType.description: iOS-specific alert type for text input.

properties.onPress: function - Callback when button is pressed
properties.isPreferred: boolean (iOS only) - Whether button is emphasized

properties.cancelable: boolean (Android) - Whether alert can be dismissed by tapping outside
properties.onDismiss: function (Android) - Callback when alert is dismissed

notes: On Android, only up to 3 buttons are supported: neutral, negative, positive.
On iOS, any number of buttons can be provided with optional style and preferred emphasis.
Alerts on Android can be dismissed by tapping outside if cancelable=true is provided.
Prompt alerts with text input are available only on iOS.
